text:
Type: white sculptural globe pendant lamp
Use: ambient light over a dining table or a sitting area; dining room, living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, modern
Materials: curved white plastic strips forming the shade, inner diffuser, white ceiling cup, thin suspension wires
Colors: white, soft warm glow
Shape: wide flattened globe made of overlapping curved bands with gaps that let light out, hangs from a dome canopy on fine wires, large but airy
Feel: airy, elegant, soft, sculptural
Goes with: white walls, light wood, grey or beige textiles; Scandinavian, contemporary or minimalist rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: You can either hang the lamp close to the ceiling in your living room or low over a coffee table.
